item.title: ISP Investigates crash following Elkhart County Sheriff’s Office Pursuit
item.description: The Elkhart County Sheriff’s Office requested the Indiana State Police to investigate after a pursuit ended in a crash in Elkhart today, Tuesday, Jan. 13.

item.title: BANTER: The Man Who Climbs Trees
item.description: In our world of machinery, where so much work is done from the safety of a console, there are still places where machines can't go, where the job still requires a human being.

item.title: Park Board Discusses Five-Year Park Project Plans
item.description: The Syracuse Parks and Recreation Board discussed ongoing projects and long-term plans at its Monday, Jan. 12, meeting.

item.title: Kosciusko BZA Discusses Petitions For Two Syracuse Residences
item.description: The Kosciusko County Board of Zoning Appeals discussed multiple petitions for two Syracuse residences on North Kings Drive during a Tuesday, Jan. 13, board meeting.

item.title: Etna Green Council Approves Completion Of Wastewater Preliminary Engineering Review
item.description: The Etna Green Town Council approved a task order for Commonwealth Engineers to complete the town's wastewater preliminary engineering review during a Tuesday, Jan. 13, council meeting.

item.title: Wawasee School Board Reorganizes, Reviews Finances, Approves Wage, Program Updates
item.description: The Wawasee School Board reorganized for the new year and approved a series of financial, personnel and instructional items during its regular meeting Tuesday, Jan. 13, while also hearing updates on teacher grants and potential education legislation.

item.title: Pierceton Council Agrees To Fiber Line
item.description: The Pierceton Town Council agreed to an easement of a right of way for the maintenance, inspection and repair of a fiber line.
